name: aisi-tracker
title: AI Security Institutes tracker
description: Which states have an AI Security Institute (AISI), covering all 193 UN member states plus Taiwan and the EU AI Office, with funding, staff and leadership where published. Every record cites its sources.
license_note: Quotations from sources remain with their rights holders and are reproduced as quotations; the licence covers our own compilation, text and data.

in_house.label: Tests in house
in_house.definition: A source reports testing or evaluation of AI models that the institute itself has carried out or is carrying out, with its own staff or facilities. A statement of role or focus does not count. For a federation, only testing that a source attributes to the institute counts.

via_other_bodies.label: Testing by other bodies
via_other_bodies.definition: A source states that a named body outside the institute, such as a contractor or partner lab, tests or evaluates models for it.

planned.label: Testing planned
planned.definition: Adopted text, not a proposal, sets up testing capacity in the future.

not_published.label: Not published
not_published.definition: Searched; no source found states it. The dated search log is recorded with the value.

recent_access.label: Yes
recent_access.definition: The latest recorded access event falls within the twelve months up to the data date.

earlier_access.label: Yes, evidence from <year>
earlier_access.definition: Access events are recorded, the latest more than twelve months before the data date; the label gives its year.

by_law.label: By law
by_law.definition: No access event is recorded, but an operative legal provision gives the institute a power to require access to models.

access_agreed.label: Access agreed
access_agreed.definition: No access event or legal power is recorded, but a developer with a frontier model has published an agreement with the institute that provides for access to, or evaluation of, its models.

none_found.label: None found
none_found.definition: Searched; no source found records access, a legal power or an agreement. The dated search log is recorded with the value.

own_staff.label: Own staff
own_staff.definition: A source states that the institute employs people in posts of its own or recruits for them, including as a unit of a ministry, government department or the European Commission.

member_bodies.label: Staff of existing bodies
member_bodies.definition: The institute is a federation of existing bodies, and a source states that their staff do its work.

core_with_partners.label: Core team with partners
core_with_partners.definition: A source states that partner institutions do the institute's research or testing under its programme, and any central team of its own only coordinates, sets policy or represents it.

host_unit.label: Unit in a host body
host_unit.definition: The institute is a unit of an agency, public research body or university, and a source states that its staff are the host's, are hired through the host's recruitment, or that an existing unit of the host was designated as the institute.

planned.label: Planned
planned.definition: Adopted text, not a proposal, sets up the staffing in the future.

not_published.label: Not published
not_published.definition: Searched; no source found states it. The dated search log is recorded with the value.

membership_body.intl-network: International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science (until December 2025: International Network of AI Safety Institutes). Members are countries and the EU; the member list is complete, so a jurisdiction without this entry is not a member.

timeline_event.exploration_started: An act meeting the exploring rung of the ladder in dataset.method. Implies exploring.
timeline_event.proposed: An act meeting the proposed rung of the ladder in dataset.method. Implies proposed.
timeline_event.commitment: An act meeting the planned rung of the ladder in dataset.method. Implies planned.
timeline_event.designated: An act meeting the established rung of the ladder in dataset.method. Implies established.
timeline_event.launched: Public start of work. No status effect.
timeline_event.first_output: Earliest identified publication credited to the institute by name, including guidance and named network contributions. No status effect.
timeline_event.withdrawn: Withdraws the earlier event named in 'withdraws'; status is recomputed from the surviving events.
timeline_event.closed: The institute is wound up; status returns to none_identified unless a later event applies.
timeline_event.mandate_changed: The institute mandate changes without establishing or closing it. No status effect.
timeline_event.named: A name for the institute or a documented predecessor comes into use where no other recorded event gives it. No status effect.
timeline_event.partner_call: Call for institutions to collaborate with the institute. No status effect.
timeline_event.related_body_planned: An official plan for a related body that does not qualify as an institute under dataset.method. No status effect.

source_origin.International Network for Advanced AI Me: Current name of the network formerly named International Network of AI Safety Institutes; historical publication names remain distinct vocabulary values for the same body.
source_origin.International Network of AI Safety Insti: Former name of the same international network now named International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science; retained when used by the cited publication.

member.label: member
member.definition: The institute is a federation of existing bodies and its founding text lists the partner as a constituent.

works_with.label: works with
works_with.definition: A text in force assigns the partner a specific task with the institute; an adopted programme for the current period that assigns the work counts as in force.

planned.label: planned
planned.definition: The text is in the future tense or sets a mandate, and no current joint work is quoted.

model_testing.label: Model testing
model_testing.definition: It ran or commissioned tests (evaluations) of AI models that a text reports in enough detail to show real tests (how many, of what kind of model or test, or by what method), or a text assigns it testing AI models or systems.
model_testing.summary: Tests AI models or systems itself, or commissions such tests.

evaluation_methods.label: Evaluation methods and tools
evaluation_methods.definition: It develops or publishes test methods, benchmarks, protocols or software; running existing benchmarks is model testing.
evaluation_methods.summary: Develops or publishes test methods, benchmarks or testing software.

research.label: Research
research.definition: It conducts or funds research on a named AI-risk topic or programme that meets no other test.
research.summary: Conducts or funds research on AI risks.

standards_guidance.label: Standards and guidelines
standards_guidance.definition: It publishes, or is tasked to develop, standards, codes or guidance addressed to AI developers, providers or deployers; no addressee or facilitating others' text does not count.
standards_guidance.summary: Issues or develops standards, codes or guidance for organisations that build or deploy AI.

regulatory_enforcement.label: Enforces AI rules
regulatory_enforcement.definition: It enforces AI rules itself: investigates, sanctions or holds legal powers over providers.
regulatory_enforcement.summary: Enforces AI rules itself: can investigate providers and impose penalties.

regulatory_support.label: Supports regulators
regulatory_support.definition: A text gives it a role supporting regulators or the implementation of AI regulation.
regulatory_support.summary: Gives regulators technical support or helps put AI rules into practice.

risk_monitoring.label: Capability and risk monitoring
risk_monitoring.definition: It reports regularly on what AI can do or what risks emerge (a periodic, numbered or continuing series, or a monitoring mandate), or a text describes it as monitoring or tracking AI capabilities or risks on an ongoing basis; one paper does not count.
risk_monitoring.summary: Tracks AI capabilities and emerging risks on an ongoing basis.

foresight.label: Foresight
foresight.definition: It publishes, or is tasked with, explicit forecasts, scenarios or early-warning indicators about future developments; threat models of current misuse do not count.
foresight.summary: Produces forecasts, scenarios or early-warning indicators of future AI developments.

policy_advice.label: Policy advice
policy_advice.definition: It advises government or parliament on AI policy or legislation, or a text tasks it to: advice, recommendations, options or policy research addressed to them, published or not; general reporting on capabilities and risks is risk monitoring, and support for rules already in force is regulator support; the addressee may be implied when a government text tasks a government body.
policy_advice.summary: Advises government or parliament on AI policy or legislation.

incident_response.label: National incident role
incident_response.definition: It holds a standing national role, without an end date, in collecting, reporting or responding to AI incidents.
incident_response.summary: Has a standing role in collecting, reporting or responding to AI incidents.

international_cooperation.label: International cooperation
international_cooperation.definition: It takes part for its jurisdiction in international networks, joint testing or agreements with foreign counterparts.
international_cooperation.summary: Works with counterparts abroad through networks, joint testing or formal agreements.

convening.label: Convening
convening.definition: It hosts, chairs or coordinates a national consortium or standing partnership, or is designated the national hub or contact point.
convening.summary: Hosts or coordinates a consortium or standing partnership, or is the designated hub or contact point on AI.

capacity_building.label: Capacity building
capacity_building.definition: A named programme or mandate clause builds named kinds of domestic organisations' ability to understand, evaluate or safely use advanced AI.
capacity_building.summary: Helps other organisations understand, evaluate or safely use advanced AI.

talent.label: Talent
talent.definition: It trains, educates or funds people outside its own staff, or a text tasks it with nurturing talent; education or training confined to its own staff does not count.
talent.summary: Trains, educates or funds people outside its own staff to build AI expertise.

adoption.label: Adoption and competitiveness
adoption.definition: A text gives it a role in promoting AI uptake, commercialisation or the domestic industry.
adoption.summary: Promotes the use of AI, its commercialisation or the domestic AI industry.

public_access_continuity.label: Access and continuity for public bodies
public_access_continuity.definition: It secures access to frontier models or compute for other public bodies, or assesses the jurisdiction's dependence on frontier AI.
public_access_continuity.summary: Arranges access to frontier models or compute for public bodies, or assesses dependence on frontier AI.

certification.label: Certification and conformity
certification.definition: It certifies AI models, systems or products, or assesses their conformity with rules or standards, or a text tasks it to; testing done to certify or assess conformity is this code, not model testing.
certification.summary: Certifies AI systems or checks whether they meet rules or standards.

sandbox.label: Regulatory sandbox
sandbox.definition: It runs, or a text tasks it to set up or run, a regulatory sandbox where AI is developed or tested under a regulator's supervision.
sandbox.summary: Runs a scheme where companies can try out AI systems under a regulator's supervision before release.

public_body.label: Named public body or programme
public_body.definition: The quoted act creates, funds or assigns a named public body or national programme for AI.

testing_duty.label: Testing duty
testing_duty.definition: The quoted act requires or plans testing, assessment or certification of AI systems.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable row identity, scoped by institute_id, jurisdiction_id or source_id where present. Natural-key aliases: outputs use lineage; known activity uses kind; functions use code; exchange rates use currency; closest candidates use jurisdiction_id. Source excerpts use SHA-256 of exact quotation text; duplicate quotations share this quote identity and binding or URL edits retain it. Quotation edits change its content identity. Event IDs combine origin_kind and origin_id.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: state = UN member state; territory = non-UN jurisdiction tracked because readers look for it (e.g. Taiwan); supranational = EU.

fields.name: europe_scope
fields.description: True for the 32 states counted on the Europe page (EU-27, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, UK, Switzerland).

fields.name: iso3
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code; null for the EU.

fields.name: m49
fields.description: UN M49 numeric code as a three-digit string; null for the EU.

fields.name: wikidata
fields.description: Verified Wikidata entity QID; null or omitted when no matching item was identified.

fields.name: identifier_source_ids
fields.description: Citations supporting identifiers, distinct from citations for status; see sources.csv.

fields.name: identifier_notes
fields.description: Identifier distinctions, inapplicability or unsuccessful exact-item searches.

fields.name: region
fields.description: UN M49 region and sub-region, from data/reference/roster.csv.

fields.name: memberships
fields.description: Codes of international bodies the jurisdiction belongs to, separated by '; '; codes are defined in dataset.vocabularies.membership_body.

fields.name: memberships_source_ids
fields.description: Source ids supporting the memberships (all memberships combined, deduplicated), separated by '; '; see sources.csv.

fields.name: population_year
fields.description: Year of the population figure; in funding.csv, of the population that eur_per_person_est divides by, empty when that ratio is empty.

fields.name: population_source_ids
fields.description: Source ids for the population figure; in funding.csv, for the population that eur_per_person_est divides by, empty when that ratio is empty.

fields.name: gdp
fields.description: Gross domestic product in current national currency (World Bank WDI), recorded only for states with a compared annual budget; empty otherwise. The share-of-GDP denominator; rule budget-ratios in dataset.method.

fields.name: gdp_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the gdp value is in.

fields.name: gdp_year
fields.description: Calendar year of the GDP figure; in funding.csv, of the GDP that share_of_gdp_est divides by, empty when that ratio is empty.

fields.name: gdp_source_ids
fields.description: Source ids for the GDP figure; in funding.csv, for the GDP that share_of_gdp_est divides by, empty when that ratio is empty; see sources.csv.

fields.name: status_confidence
fields.description: Confidence in the status: high, medium or low (rule in dataset.method).

fields.name: institute_id
fields.description: Institute record ID; see institutes.csv or institutes[].id in aisi.json.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One or two plain sentences a non-expert can read.

fields.name: related_bodies
fields.description: Nearby bodies a reader might mistake for an AISI (AI Act authorities, cyber centres), and why they are not counted.

fields.name: last_checked
fields.description: Recorded date of the last full record check; last_checked_basis states whether this is evidenced or a historical upper bound. Partial checks do not advance it.

fields.name: last_checked_basis
fields.description: recorded_full_check means a recorded full check; historical_upper_bound means the original full-check log is unavailable and the date does not guarantee freshness. Empty means the basis is not recorded.

fields.name: check_method
fields.description: individual = sources searched and read one by one; broad_search = region-wide searches only.

fields.name: source_ids
fields.description: Source ids, separated by '; '; see sources.csv.

fields.name: source_urls
fields.description: URLs of the cited sources, same order as source_ids.

Source excerpts use SHA-256 of exact quotation text; duplicate quotations share this quote identity and binding or URL edits retain it. Quotation edits change its content identity. Event IDs combine origin_kind and origin_id.

fields.name: short_name
fields.description: Recorded short form of the display name for tight places such as table cells. It is unique among institutes and never a bare generic acronym such as AISI; the page gives the full name on hover.

fields.name: wikidata
fields.description: Verified Wikidata entity QID; null or omitted when no matching item was identified.

fields.name: identifier_source_ids
fields.description: Citations supporting identifiers, distinct from citations for status; see sources.csv.

fields.name: identifier_notes
fields.description: Identifier distinctions, inapplicability or unsuccessful exact-item searches.

fields.name: announced
fields.description: Generated date of the first commitment or proposal event in the jurisdiction timeline, withdrawn acts included; absent from authored data. Null when no such event is recorded: a designation is never read as an announcement. The same reading starts the announcement intervals.

fields.name: established
fields.description: Generated date of the first designation whose act has not been withdrawn. A later closure retains this historical date.

fields.name: announced_to_established_days_min
fields.description: Shortest reading, in signed whole days, of the interval from the first commitment or proposal event to the establishment; empty when not recorded. Equal bounds mean the interval is exact once each date is bounded (a month-only or year-only date ends no later than dataset.as_of). Rule in dataset.method (Intervals between milestones); see institutes[].intervals in the JSON schema.

fields.name: announced_to_established_days_max
fields.description: Longest reading, in signed whole days, of the interval from the first commitment or proposal event to the establishment; empty when not recorded. Equal bounds mean the interval is exact once each date is bounded (a month-only or year-only date ends no later than dataset.as_of). Rule in dataset.method (Intervals between milestones); see institutes[].intervals in the JSON schema.

fields.name: established_to_first_qualifying_activity_days_min
fields.description: Shortest reading, in signed whole days, of the interval from the establishment to the first qualifying activity; empty when not recorded or the institute is not currently established. Equal bounds mean the interval is exact once each date is bounded (a month-only or year-only date ends no later than dataset.as_of). Rule in dataset.method (Intervals between milestones); see institutes[].intervals in the JSON schema.

fields.name: established_to_first_qualifying_activity_days_max
fields.description: Longest reading, in signed whole days, of the interval from the establishment to the first qualifying activity; empty when not recorded or the institute is not currently established. Equal bounds mean the interval is exact once each date is bounded (a month-only or year-only date ends no later than dataset.as_of). Rule in dataset.method (Intervals between milestones); see institutes[].intervals in the JSON schema.

fields.name: announced_to_first_qualifying_activity_days_min
fields.description: Shortest reading, in signed whole days, of the interval from the first commitment or proposal event to the first qualifying activity; empty when not recorded or the institute is not currently established. Equal bounds mean the interval is exact once each date is bounded (a month-only or year-only date ends no later than dataset.as_of). Rule in dataset.method (Intervals between milestones); see institutes[].intervals in the JSON schema.

fields.name: announced_to_first_qualifying_activity_days_max
fields.description: Longest reading, in signed whole days, of the interval from the first commitment or proposal event to the first qualifying activity; empty when not recorded or the institute is not currently established. Equal bounds mean the interval is exact once each date is bounded (a month-only or year-only date ends no later than dataset.as_of). Rule in dataset.method (Intervals between milestones); see institutes[].intervals in the JSON schema.

fields.name: host
fields.description: Where it sits: ministry, agency, university, or a federation of bodies.

fields.name: mandate_short
fields.description: One plain line of about 15 words for the page card. Where the body's remit is wider than the tracked function, the line says so.

fields.name: website
fields.description: null = no own website found.

fields.name: legal_basis
fields.description: Act giving the institute its qualifying mandate: law, decree, cabinet_decision, ministerial_act, administrative or none_found.

fields.name: legal_basis_state
fields.description: in_force, or foreseen for planned and proposed institutes.

fields.name: host_type
fields.description: Where the institute sits: ministry, government_agency, public_research_body, university, supranational, multiple (network of bodies) or unknown.

fields.name: head_state
fields.description: State of the head row: stated, not_published or not_applicable (schema: institutes[].head).

fields.name: head_person_id
fields.description: ID of the institute's head in people.csv (top executive by published title, chair excluded); empty unless head_state is stated.

fields.name: reports_to_state
fields.description: State of the reporting-line row: stated, not_published or not_applicable.

fields.name: reports_to
fields.description: Ministry-level body the institute answers to, one above an agency, university or research host (equal to the host for a ministry host), in the source's language; several bodies are joined with '; '.

fields.name: reports_to_en
fields.description: Faithful English translation of reports_to; empty when the name is already English.

fields.name: national_partners_state
fields.description: State of the national partners row: stated, not_published or not_applicable; entries are in national_partners.csv.

fields.name: head_notes
fields.description: Search log for the head row: what was searched, in which languages and when (required unless stated).

fields.name: reports_to_notes
fields.description: Search log for the reporting-line row (required unless stated).

fields.name: national_partners_notes
fields.description: Search log for the national partners row, including the cyber agency searched and the date when no cyber partner is listed.

fields.name: name_history
fields.description: Names oldest first, with start date (the date of the timeline event that gave the name) and source ids.

fields.name: testing_capacity
fields.description: Testing modes a source states, joined with '; ' in the order in_house, via_other_bodies; or planned or not_published. Empty when not recorded. Rule in dataset.method (Testing capacity and model access); labels in dataset.vocabularies.testing_capacity.

fields.name: testing_capacity_source_ids
fields.description: Sources for testing_capacity: the plan's, then each mode's, then the notes'; see sources.csv. Per-mode sources are in aisi.json.

fields.name: testing_capacity_notes
fields.description: Notes on testing_capacity: a proposal quoted with its source and date, explicit negative statements, joint network testing reported with its date, or a newer source contradicting an older one.

fields.name: testing_capacity_searches
fields.description: Search log for a not_published testing_capacity, as 'date (language): query' joined with '; '; the sources read are in aisi.json.

fields.name: model_access
fields.description: Generated model access value: recent_access (latest access event within the twelve months up to as_of), earlier_access, by_law, access_agreed or none_found. Empty when not recorded. Rule in dataset.method (Testing capacity and model access); labels in dataset.vocabularies.model_access.

fields.name: model_access_latest_event
fields.description: Generated: date of the latest access event, on or before which that access took place; empty without events.

fields.name: model_access_events
fields.description: Access events as 'date developer model (kind)' joined with '; '; the access took place on or before the date; kind is pre_release or deeper_than_public. Full records in aisi.json.

fields.name: model_access_legal_power
fields.description: The legal power to require model access, as '<act>, <article>'; conditions are in aisi.json. Empty when none is recorded.

fields.name: model_access_agreement_ids
fields.description: IDs in agreements.csv of developer agreements providing for access to, or evaluation of, the developer's models, joined with '; '.

fields.name: model_access_source_ids
fields.description: Sources for model access events, the legal power, developer agreements and the notes; see sources.csv.

fields.name: model_access_notes
fields.description: Notes on model access: access to models outside Epoch AI's frontier set, access from other developers, unknown contractor access, or a newer source contradicting an older one.

fields.name: model_access_searches
fields.description: Search log when nothing is recorded, as 'date (language): query' joined with '; '; the sources read are in aisi.json.

fields.name: staffing_model
fields.description: How a source states the institute is staffed: own_staff, member_bodies, core_with_partners or host_unit; or planned or not_published. Empty when not recorded. Rule in dataset.method (Staffing model); labels in dataset.vocabularies.staffing_model. Dated headcounts are in staff.csv.

fields.name: staffing_model_source_ids
fields.description: Sources for staffing_model and its notes; see sources.csv.

fields.name: staffing_model_notes
fields.description: Notes on staffing_model: secondments, concurrent posts or contractors beside the main model, history from older sources, a proposal quoted with its source and date, or a newer source contradicting an older one.

fields.name: staffing_model_searches
fields.description: Search log for a not_published staffing_model, as 'date (language): query' joined with '; '; the sources read are in aisi.json.

fields.name: staffing_profile
fields.description: How the institute gets its people: direct hires, secondees, partner institutes.

fields.name: units_per_eur
